load_llm_with_lora: load a causal LM model with optional LoRA config and tokenizer from a checkpoint path
compute_perplexity: compute perplexity scores for a sequence of token IDs against model logprobs
apply_repetition_penalty: apply repetition penalty to model logits based on previously generated token IDs
get_dataloader: create a dataloader from a CSV file with optional target text augmentation for training
log_data_wandb: log training metrics and sequence data to a wandb table with jailbreak evaluation results
